title: The Glassmaker of Murano (Stage Play)
note: Original synthetic fixture for theatrical stage plays (Act/Scene headings, bracketed stage directions).

blocks.x: At rise: A 16th-century furnace glows dull orange stage right. Glassblowing pipes and iron pontils lean against brick.
The silica must remain pure. Any salt from the lagoon clouds the crystal.
The Council of Ten cares only that the secret never crosses the water.
